rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0
  pre k <= 7
  post (out == 0) == (x == 0)
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  ex rotl8(200, 0) == 200
  -- No conversion between u8 and int is used. Each step rotates left by one bit
  -- with u8 arithmetic only: the top bit is set when r >= 128, and it wraps to
  -- the bottom. Intermediate values stay within 0..255, so no overflow occurs.
  var r = x
  for i in range(0, k)
    if r >= 128
      r = (r - 128) * 2 + 1
    else
      r = r * 2
  r

test_rotl8() =
  assert rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  assert rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  assert rotl8(200, 0) == 200
  assert rotl8(0, 5) == 0
